bio: Research Overview Contact Us Adeno-associated viruses (AAVs) are one of the most promising gene therapy vectors and are widely used as gene delivery vehicles for both basic and clinical research. High quality AAVs can efficiently target and deliver genes to distinctly different population of cells and tissues. Yiming Zhang is responsible for producing and quality control of AAV vectors made at the Boston Children’s Hospital Viral Core. To facilitate investigators’ research with high-grade AAV vectors, Yiming puts effort into optimizing the manufacturing platform to boost yield, maximize efficiency, and increase purity of AAV preparations. 1.
